"""Verify actual receipts and prepare lossless archive bytes outside the maintained tree."""

import argparse
from pathlib import Path

from common import (
    DOSSIER,
    GATES,
    ROOT,
    bind,
    check_inputs,
    external_new,
    input_config,
    now,
    read,
    verify,
    wrapper,
    write,
)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument("--config", required=True, type=Path)
    ap.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    cfg = input_config(args.config)
    adoption, gates, preservation, assessment, tested = check_inputs(cfg)
    output = external_new(args.output)
    output.mkdir()
    prepared = output / "prepared"
    prepared.mkdir()
    mappings = []

    def add(name, original, mode="exact", **extra):
        destination = DOSSIER + "/final-gates/" + name
        assert destination not in {x["destination"] for x in mappings}
        assert not (ROOT / destination).exists()
        verify(original)
        dest = prepared / name
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        if mode == "lossless_utf8":
            write(dest, wrapper(original["path"]))
            assert read(dest)["text"].encode() == Path(original["path"]).read_bytes()
        else:
            with dest.open("xb") as stream:
                stream.write(Path(original["path"]).read_bytes())
        mappings.append(
            {
                "destination": destination,
                "prepared": bind(dest),
                "original": original,
                "mode": mode,
                **extra,
            }
        )

    names = {
        "adoption": "actual-adoption.json",
        "gates": "execution.json",
        "preservation": "preservation.json",
        "tested_inputs": "tested-inputs.json",
        "page_qa": "page-qa.json",
        "visual_observation": "visual-observation.json",
        "root_assessment": "root-assessment.json",
        "display_approval": "approved-node-display-delta.json",
        "display_assessment": "node-display-assessment.json",
    }
    for key, name in names.items():
        if key in cfg:
            add(name, cfg[key])
    for receipt in gates["receipts"]:
        assert receipt["name"] in GATES
        for stream in ["stdout", "stderr"]:
            add(receipt["name"] + "." + stream + ".json", receipt[stream], "lossless_utf8")
    for item in cfg.get("additional_artifacts", []):
        add(
            item["name"],
            item["original"],
            item["mode"],
            **{k: item[k] for k in ["projection_description", "full_original"] if k in item},
        )
    summary = {
        "status": "actual_receipts_verified_pending_root_archive",
        "at": now(),
        "config": bind(args.config),
        "root": str(ROOT),
        "mappings": mappings,
        "actual_gate_summary": assessment["gate_summary"],
        "actual_visual_summary": assessment["visual_summary"],
        "tested_bindings_verified": len(tested),
        "baseline_records": 227,
        "baseline_pages": 227,
        "baseline_review_bundles": 101,
        "preservation": bind(cfg["preservation"]["path"]),
        "maintained_writes": False,
        "saved_native_review": False,
    }
    write(output / "archive-plan.json", summary)
    print(bind(output / "archive-plan.json"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
